statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-119195 (GHSA-9m75-vc3g-4x39): pyasn1: Quadratic-time denial of service in constructed string and indefinite-length ANY decoding. Upstream fixed it in pyasn1 0.6.5 (https://github.com/pyasn1/pyasn1/releases/tag/v0.6.5, https://github.com/pyasn1/pyasn1/security/advisories/GHSA-9m75-vc3g-4x39, https://github.com/pyasn1/pyasn1/commit/4ce00797c594b59c1fd6b86d9ebc3ba87b7ec9f9, https://github.com/pyasn1/pyasn1/pull/132, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9m75-vc3g-4x39). k8s-sidecar is a Python application installed in a virtual environment with its dependencies. Checked every published k8s-sidecar package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, 2.10.1-r0 to the current 2.14.3-r5, x86_64 and aarch64: every build from 2.10.1-r0 to 2.11.2-r3 ships pyasn1 0.6.4, which is affected, and k8s-sidecar no longer installs pyasn1 from 2.13.3-r0 onwards, so no build from 2.13.3-r0 to 2.14.3-r5 contains pyasn1 at all. The range ends at 2.13.3-r0.
